name: longlivethepeople
description: Archived Long Live the People memorial web application
author: noirisaesthetic

scripts.dev:server: cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon --watch apps/server/src --ext ts --exec node apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @longlivethepeople/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @longlivethepeople/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=test playwright test
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:e2e:ci
